# Social

Profile headers, ready to upload. Both use the `ink` ground, the white wordmark and the big D at 14% `blue`. Neither carries any text besides the wordmark, so neither needs updating when the copy changes. The SVG versions are the editable sources.

- `x-header-1500x500.png`: the X header. The wordmark sits left of centre, clear of the profile picture.
- `linkedin-cover-1128x191.png`: the LinkedIn company page cover. The wordmark sits in the middle, because LinkedIn puts the logo over the left side.

Use `../logos/doefin-icon-blue.png` as the profile picture on both.
